skills.name: wilma
skills.description: Read a family's Wilma (Finnish school system): schedule, homework, exams, grades, messages, news and attachments, through the WilmAI MCP tools or the wilma CLI.

skills.name: wilma-triage
skills.description: Daily triage of Wilma school notifications: filters for actionable items, adds exam dates to the family calendar when a calendar tool is available, and reports via chat. Requires the wilma skill.
